args.text: Popcorn shop. Top: 0 coins, back, sparkle, sound, restart buttons. Three customers at a counter want popcorn. Middle: empty kitchen with a hopper and a crane hook. Bottom (highlighted red): a popcorn machine with a ring dial - red, yellow, blue zones and a white dot on the yellow, plus a gauge needle. Locked slots on the right. Bottom panel: upgrade for 30 coins, +4 to +6. I think I press the popcorn machine (maybe hold it?) to cook, and the ring is a timing meter. I'll tap the machine first.

Tapping the machine made a popcorn puff appear up on the crane in the middle kitchen. The white dot on the ring jumped from the yellow zone to the blue right side. A 4th customer arrived. Maybe the dot travels around the ring and tapping when it's in yellow is a better pop? Tapping again to see what the crane does.

8 coins! A customer got served and left. The upgrade panel at the bottom started filling with yellow (8/30 I guess). The dot stayed on the right of the ring. Satisfying little loop: tap machine -> popcorn -> crane -> customer -> coins. Going to tap several times to reach 30.

16 coins. The yellow arc on the ring flashed white when I tapped - maybe that's a 'good' hit? Popcorn now piles in the hopper and a striped bucket is under the crane. Wondering if the ring wants a HOLD rather than a tap - the dot might run around while I hold. Trying a 1.5s hold.

Holding did something bigger: kernels sprayed out, 2 of the 8 little dots under the machine lit up gold, and I jumped to 32 coins. The upgrade panel turned bright yellow with a red arrow - I can afford it. Buying the machine upgrade (+4 -> +6).

Upgrade bought - the machine grew a striped awning, next costs 54 for +6->+8. Coins already back at 20. Now the red outline jumped to the middle kitchen (crane/hopper) panel. Is that telling me the kitchen is the bottleneck, or that I should tap it? Tapping the bucket icon at its top-left corner.

Tapping the kitchen icon opened its info card: a crane picture with stats 1>1, a clock 4.0>3.0, and 15>20, and the bottom upgrade now costs 250 for 15->20. Way too expensive for my 30 coins. So each floor has its own upgrade. The ring dot is now near the top-right, arrows on the ring point clockwise. I think the dot travels clockwise and yellow is the sweet spot, red = burnt (there's a smoke puff on top). Watching it for 2s.

Dot crawled from top-right to the right side in ~2s on its own, coins didn't change while I waited - nothing happens unless I act. Kitchen counter went 7 -> 6. Now trying a long 3s hold on the machine to see if holding pushes the dot around toward the yellow zone.

Oops - huge black smoke cloud over the machine. Held 3s = burnt, no coins. Now it clicks: holding cooks, the dot sweeps the ring clockwise from the top, blue = not ready, yellow = perfect, red = burnt. My 1.5s hold earlier was a perfect one. Customers piling up and one frowns. Trying 1.6s.

Perfect! Kernels burst out, the release marker landed in the yellow and the row of dots under the machine is 4/8 gold - a streak/combo meter? Feels good. Worried though: the kitchen's bucket counter keeps dropping 7-6-4-2. Will it run out? Doing another 1.6s hold.
48 coins, dots 6/8 with a bigger gold circle at the end of the row - I bet filling it gives a bonus. Customers cleared out happily. Two more perfect holds to see what happens at 8.

58 coins. The dot row filled and reset back to 2/8 - didn't notice an obvious reward, but the kitchen now has 4 full buckets lined up and the hopper is full (counter 7 / 3). The black board top-left by the counter lit 3 yellow dots - no idea what it tracks. Customers ran out. Switching the bottom panel back to the machine (its icon) to buy the 54 upgrade.
68 coins. Machine card: 6>8, star 500>550, loop 400>400, next model on wheels. Upgrade is lit - buying it.

Upgrade bought - the machine is now a big cart on wheels, next is 97 for +8>+11. Another perfect hold. Now the red outline is on the counter at the top and the kitchen has 7 full buckets stacked but only one customer - customers look like the bottleneck now. Would want to upgrade the shop next.
